LASP 201.description: Interdisciplinary introduction to the diversity of landscapes and political and social issues in Latin America’s history. Films, lectures, and readings provide an overall comprehensive perspective. Lectures by faculty in Spanish, Portuguese, anthropology, and history.
LASP 201.subject: LASP
LASP 201.title: Latin American, Caribbean, and Latino/a Cultures through Film

LASP 301.description: Anthropology, geography, history, politics, language, and culture of Latin America.
LASP 301.subject: LASP
LASP 301.title: Interdisciplinary Study of Latin America

LASP 305.subject: LASP
LASP 305.title: Working with Spanish-Speaking Communities

LASP 311.subject: LASP
LASP 311.title: Latin American Cultures

LASP 341.title: Colonial Latin America

LASP 342.subject: LASP
LASP 342.title: Modern Latin America

LASP 351.description: The development, principles, political thought, and politics of the several Latin American states.

LASP 361.title: Latin American Culture

LASP 425.title: Prehistoric Archaeology of South America
